verifications.claim: A Starlink mission on Falcon 9 is scheduled to launch from Cape Canaveral on March 20, 2026.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R7: 'Starlink Mission Falcon 9 SLC-4E, California Droneship March 20, 2026'; R2: No March 20 Starlink from Cape Canaveral (March 22 SLC-40 Starlink listed).
verifications.reasoning: References indicate a Starlink launch on March 20 from SLC-4E California (Vandenberg), not Cape Canaveral (SLC-40 Florida), directly contradicting the location.

verifications.claim: A Starlink mission on Falcon 9 is scheduled to launch from Cape Canaveral on March 22, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'March 22: SpaceX Falcon 9 on the Starlink 10-62 mission with 29 Starlink satellites from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station’s Space Launch Complex 40'; R7: 'Starlink Mission Falcon 9 SLC-40, Florida Droneship March 22, 2026'.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly confirm Starlink Falcon 9 from SLC-40 Cape Canaveral on March 22, 2026.

verifications.claim: On March 19, 2026, Falcon 9 successfully launched Starlink 10-33 from Cape Canaveral.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'March 19: SpaceX Falcon 9 on the Starlink 10-33 mission with 29 Starlink satellites from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station’s Space Launch Complex 40'; R6: 'SpaceX has just launched the Falcon 9 rocket carrying 29 Starlink satellites... Starlink 10-33'.
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation of successful Starlink 10-33 Falcon 9 launch from Cape Canaveral SLC-40 on March 19, 2026.

verifications.claim: The booster for the March 19, 2026 Falcon 9 launch performed a return-to-launch-site landing.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R2: 'which made a recovery landing downrange on the droneship Just Read the Instructions'; R6: 'landed aboard SpaceX's drone ship Just Read the Instructions'; R7: 'Droneship'.
verifications.reasoning: All references confirm droneship landing (downrange), not return-to-launch-site (RTLS onshore).

verifications.claim: On March 17, 2026, Falcon 9 launched 29 Starlink satellites.

verifications.reasoning: Direct match for Falcon 9 launching 29 Starlink satellites on March 17, 2026.
